lines.en: so how'd it go it was amazing you know how you always think you're great in bed the fact that
you'd even ask that question shows how little you know me well it's like last night i couldn't do
the thing that usually makes me great so i had to do all this other stuff and the response i got
man oh man it was like a ticker tape parade
yes i know as it happens my room is very very close to the parade route
it was amazing and not just for her for me too it's like all of a sudden i'm blind but all my other
senses are heightened you know it's like i was able to appreciate it on another level
i didn't know you had another level
